## Case Study 11: Interacting with space

### Background

You can recreate [CS 10](https://byuistats.github.io/M335/weekly_projects/cs10_details.html){target="blank"} or find your own spatial data to display using [folium](https://python-visualization.github.io/folium/latest/index.html){target="blank"}.

-   [Course Website](../index.html)

### Reading

This reading will help you complete the tasks below.

-   o [Folium: Python Data, Leaflet Maps](https://python-visualization.github.io/folium/latest/index.html){target="blank"}

-   [ ] Choose an option of recreating or using new data.
    -   [ ] Recreate [CS 10](../qmd_files/modules_files/weekly_projects/cs10_details.html){target="blank"} tasks with folium
    -   [ ] Find your own spatial data that interests you and build a visualization
-   [ ] Install `folium` using UV - `uv add folium`
-   [ ] Create a marimo notebook with 1-2 paragraphs summarizing your graphics and the choices you made in your visualization
-   [ ] Export your notebook to `.html` abd have both the notebook and HTML into your git repository
